title: Fixed coordinates of a combined sign vector
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of indices in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, let $y$ assign a sign to each index in $J$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each index outside $J$. If $i$ is an index outside $J$, then the sign vector obtained by combining $y$ and $z$ has value $z(i)$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of indices in $	ext{Fin}(n)$
